items.finding: The definition of Confidential Information is mutual, as it includes information disclosed by both parties. However, the definition of Residuals is one-sided, favoring the Company, as it allows the Company to use retained knowledge without restrictions, while the Recipient is only allowed to use Residuals in a limited manner.
items.quote:
Confidential Information means all information, in any form, disclosed or made available by or on behalf of the Company to the Recipient or its Representatives, whether before or after the Effective Date, including customer and portfolio data, credit models, product plans, pricing, technology architecture, business processes, and all analyses, compilations, notes or other documents prepared by the Recipient that contain or reflect such information.

4.1 Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement, the Company shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose, including the development, marketing and procurement of products and services, provided that this Clause 4.1 does not grant any licence under any patent or copyright.
items.counterPosition: The Recipient should be allowed to use Residuals for any purpose, similar to the Company.

items.finding: The obligations are mutual, with both parties required to keep the information confidential and to return or destroy it upon request. However, the Recipient's obligations to return or destroy the information are more stringent, as they are required to do so within five business days, while the Company has no such obligation.
items.quote:
2.1 The Recipient shall: (a) use the Confidential Information solely for the purpose of evaluating and, if applicable, performing the Proposed Transaction; (b) keep the Confidential Information strictly confidential and not disclose it to any person other than its Representatives who need to know it and are bound by obligations at least as protective as this Agreement; (c) apply security measures no less stringent than those required under the Company's information-security policy as notified to the Recipient from time to time; and (d) be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.

5.1 On the Company's written request, the Recipient shall promptly, and in any event within five (5) business days, return or permanently destroy all Confidential Information and certify such destruction in writing signed by a director.
items.counterPosition: The Company should be required to return or destroy the information within a reasonable timeframe.

items.finding: The Residuals clause is one-sided, favoring the Company. The Recipient is only allowed to use Residuals in a limited manner, while the Company can use Residuals for any purpose, including the development, marketing, and procurement of products and services.
items.quote: 4.1 Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement, the Company shall be free to use Residuals for any purpose, including the development, marketing and procurement of products and services, provided that this Clause 4.1 does not grant any licence under any patent or copyright.
items.counterPosition: The Recipient should be allowed to use Residuals for any purpose, similar to the Company.

items.finding: The remedies are mutual, with both parties entitled to injunctive relief and specific performance, and the Recipient is required to indemnify the Company for any breaches.
items.quote:
10.1 The Recipient acknowledges that damages alone would not be an adequate remedy for breach of this Agreement and that the Company shall be entitled to injunctive relief and specific performance, without proof of actual damage, in addition to any other remedy.

10.2 The Recipient shall indemnify the Company for all losses, costs and expenses (including legal fees) arising from any breach of this Agreement by the Recipient or its Representatives.

items.finding: The covenants are mutual, with both parties agreeing not to provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor and not to solicit, hire, or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.
items.quote:
8.1 In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

8.2 The Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twenty-four (24) months after its termination, directly or indirectly solicit, hire or engage any employee or consultant of the Company.

items.finding: The term is mutual, with the obligations of the Recipient surviving termination and continuing in perpetuity.
items.quote: 7.2 The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.
